chunks: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab from Yazid ibn Ishaq Sha'rin from Harun ibn Hamzah al-Ghanawi who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'When you fast for its sighting and break your fast for its sighting, you have completed the fasting of the month of Ramadan.'
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for completing the fasting of Ramadan according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In the Shia scholarly tradition, this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* underscores the principle of *tawqi'* (divine timing) linked to lunar observation, distinguishing the Imami method of determining Ramadan's start and end from other schools. It highlights that the spiritual perfection of the fast is contingent upon adhering to the specific visual evidence of the crescent moon as the divinely ordained sign for both entry and exit. This reinforces the importance of following the Imam's declaration or the established sighting criteria to ensure the ritual is valid and complete.
